source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of tree applications (PDF 112-113).

items: File systems: pre-order traversal directory ka backup us ke mawad se pehle leta hai.
File system se mitana: post-order traversal walid directory se pehle sub-directories aur files mitata hai.
Darja-bandi wala data: tanzeemi charts aur family trees.
Faisla sazi: decision trees sharait se nataij chunte hain.
Syntax parsing: compilers source code ki banawat dikhane aur process karne ke liye trees banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Folder aur us ka sab kuch mitane ke liye post-order kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Folder tabhi mitaya ja sakta hai jab khali ho, aur post-order walid se pehle tamam bachche dekhta (mitata) hai.

items: Tree ke istemal: backups (pre-order), mitana (post-order), darja-bandi, decision trees, compilers.
